channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Smoking rates reach historic low among youth in the United States
item.description: Historic-low youth smoking rates should be recognised as major public health progress. The latest US data also show falling youth vaping, challenging the idea that adult access to lower-risk nicotine products inevitably drives a youth crisis. Prevention still matters, especially for those who already vape frequently, but the message should be proportionate. Protecting young people and helping adult smokers leave cigarettes behind can be part of the same strategy. (Published on August 24, 2026bygoodgoodgood.co)

item.title: Major Win | Court Ruling Could Dismantle FDA’s Flavored Vape Ban | RegWatch
item.description: The court ruling against the FDA’s approach to flavoured vapes could mark an important turning point for evidence-based regulation. Flavours are not a minor detail for many adults who switch from smoking; they can affect whether lower-risk products are acceptable enough to replace cigarettes. Youth protection remains essential, but it should be pursued through enforcement and product standards rather than blanket hostility to adult choice. A credible regulatory system should assess risk, behaviour and public health impact instead of treating flavour as automatic failure. (Published on August 24, 2026byregulatorwatch.com)
